title: How ChatGPT Reads YOUR PDFs: RAG in 50 Seconds
whyCare: Every 'chat with your docs' product is RAG; most explainers are 12-17 min long-form, and few RAG Shorts break 30K views.

evidence.claim: 'What is RAG? Completely Explained in 15 Minutes' (Apna College) 1,110,250 views, ~5 months old (YouTube search, scraped 2026-10-20)
'RAG Explained in 12 Minutes' 785,014 views (~6 months); 'Is RAG Still Needed?' (IBM) 1,067,089 views (~7 months)
Short 'What is Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)? Simplified Explanation' shows 840K views; other RAG Shorts in the same search show 9-26K (Shorts results show no upload date)

competitors.title: What is Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG)? Simplified Explanation (Short)
What is RAG? | Completely Explained in 15 Minutes (Apna College)

angle: Open-book exam analogy as one diagram: Question -> Search (vector DB) -> top 3 chunks travel as packets into the prompt -> LLM -> answer with a citation. 'Where it breaks': wrong chunk retrieved = confident wrong answer.
hook: ChatGPT never read your PDF. So how does it quote page 12?
strengths: Highest-demand AI topic; moving-packet diagram is what the engine does best; feeds a later long-form
weaknesses: Crowded long-form; many tiny RAG Shorts exist, so packaging must stand out
